summary: Added AccessHarvester identify-usage subcommand across 3 sessions. Session 1 designed the taxonomy and JSON schema. Session 2 implemented six signal collectors, classifier, question generator, and 84 unit tests. Session 3 ran pilot calibration, fixed four correctness issues (query type constants, inline SQL RecordSource scanning, form nav-target rule, table FK-child rule), committed golden fixtures for HomeHealthCare (74 objects) and NorthwindDevEdition (167 objects), and cross-provider verified VERIFIED in R1.

next_session_set.summary: Run the cleanup identifier (soft prereq for this set) against HomeHealthCare and NorthwindDevEdition, then re-run identify-usage with --exclude-cleanup to produce a usage checklist that excludes confirmed-stale objects. This completes the two-pass object-analysis arc.
